supersedes.reason: Adds final protocol-gate state, boundary revalidation, and a synthesis-ready control/threat mapping without changing the approved source boundary.

scope: Current observable behavior and documentation claims in the approved qa-gate-codex-run source boundary. This is not an evaluation of live Codex behavior, reviewer accuracy, operational security, or production readiness.

classification_legend.verified_fact: Directly observed in the named local source, deterministic test record, approval/gate record, or current boundary revalidation.
classification_legend.attributed_claim: A claim made by local documentation or source comments, without raw supporting live evidence in the authorized boundary.
classification_legend.inference: An analyst conclusion drawn from listed facts; it is not an observed runtime outcome.
classification_legend.competing_explanation: A material alternative that the authorized local evidence does not resolve.
classification_legend.unknown: A material fact absent from the authorized local evidence.

evidence_index.use: Approved scope, threat model, local-analysis contract, and synthesis-handoff requirements.
Full screening, corpus construction, and comparative evaluation are allowed; implementation is not allowed.
Current 22-file source boundary equals the calibration inventory.
Source catalog, digests, and recorded regression-test outcomes.
Four synthetic integrity-fixture unittest cases passed; no Codex or app-server call occurred.
A 200000-character bridge stdout fixture was complete and parseable; no plugin resolution or Codex turn occurred.
Criteria threshold, history prompt, chain, witness requirement, and terminal-state logic.
Verification replay and rollout comparison behavior.
Fresh postmortem, transport configuration, and bridge-flush behavior.
Documentation assertions about session restoration, witness provenance, comparative execution, and same-user limitations.

controls.mechanism: Start requires name.vN.ext; later rounds require a newer artifact with the same base.
controls.limit: It controls path/version transitions, not the semantic correctness of a version.

controls.mechanism: Prompt defines severity and requires criterion references; only findings at the configured threshold block.
controls.limit: qa_gate.py JSON-parses verdicts but does not itself validate them against verdict.schema.json.

controls.mechanism: The recorded session/thread is reused; a round refuses a transport change or session discontinuity.
controls.test_status: No live transport or resume test in the boundary.
controls.limit: Continuity of an identifier does not demonstrate that a resumed model retains the intended context.

controls.mechanism: Round 2+ asks the reviewer to compare on-disk history with its recalled prior turns; a false consistency value finalizes INTEGRITY_BREACH.
controls.test_status: No included test has a live reviewer detect forged history.
controls.limit: The mechanism depends on actual resumption and the reviewer response.

controls.mechanism: Each round chains request, response, artifact, and grounding digests; verify recomputes the chain and request/response hashes.
controls.test_status: TST-LCI-001 covers two synthetic session.json alterations.
controls.limit: Hashes establish equality to recorded bytes, not independent origin or semantic truth.

controls.mechanism: Verify finds a current-user rollout file and checks counts, request and response bodies, available turn context, sandbox, cwd, and roots.
controls.test_status: TST-LCI-001 uses synthetic rollout fixtures only.
controls.limit: Empty workspace_roots is accepted, and sandbox/cwd checks occur only when recorded turn context is present.

controls.mechanism: Verify compares the current artifact digest to the final round and recomputes pass conditions from the final response.
controls.test_status: TST-LCI-001 includes terminal-state flip and artifact-substitution cases.
controls.limit: The binding does not make an erroneous reviewer PASS correct.

controls.mechanism: Execution copies direct artifact-parent siblings except QA and deprecated into QA/exec; non-execution review uses the artifact parent.
controls.test_status: No actual sandbox test is included.
controls.limit: The copy and caller-selected grounding can expose unrelated files; enforcement depends on the external sandbox.

controls.mechanism: Each round hashes grounding files and folds the ordered digest into its chain.
controls.limit: Verify compares recorded rounds but does not rehash current grounding at verification time.

controls.mechanism: Configured iteration/retry limits and repeated-finding fingerprints terminate stalled review.
controls.limit: Stopping avoids unbounded looping but cannot decide whether the remaining finding is valid.

controls.mechanism: Postmortem invokes Codex with resume_id=None and records a separate session/report.
controls.limit: cmd_verify does not authenticate the later postmortem witness.

controls.mechanism: The bridge exits from stdout's write callback.
controls.limit: This covers response delivery, not plugin resolution, schema enforcement, or reviewer quality.

threat_assessments.threat: Artifact substitution or untracked version transition

residual.statement: Path and digest binding reduce specified substitution opportunities but do not validate artifact semantics.

threat_assessments.threat: Rubric ambiguity or preference becoming a blocking defect

residual.statement: No blinded corpus result establishes the rate at which criterion-linked prompting avoids false blocks.
No local comparative evaluation has measured false-pass, false-block, abstention, or evidence quality.

threat_assessments.threat: Reviewer drift, dialogue convergence, or correlated producer/reviewer error

residual.statement: Fresh contexts and postmortems are procedural separation, not a separate model, organization, incentive, or cryptographic trust root.

threat_assessments.threat: Forged, incomplete, or mutable local records

residual.explanation_a: A clean verify result is useful evidence that the checked local records and a current-user rollout agree.
residual.explanation_b: A same-user adversary might alter local stores together; the protocol itself disclaims cryptographic unforgeability.
residual.status: Both explanations fit the authorized local evidence.

threat_assessments.threat: Mutable artifact, criteria, or grounding evidence

residual.statement: Current grounding files are not rehashed by verify; only recorded round-to-round grounding changes are checked.

threat_assessments.threat: Prompt injection, untrusted-artifact effects, or excess execution authority

residual.statement: No live evidence establishes sandbox enforcement, effective least privilege, or prompt-injection resistance in the deployment environment.

threat_assessments.threat: Confidentiality or portability failure from path and copy semantics

residual.statement: Execution copies all direct sibling files/directories other than literal QA and deprecated, and --ground-dir recursively includes files.
The stop rules constrain a single gate session but do not constitute the research plan's cross-workstream cost ledger or prove a correct terminal classification.
The included fixture does not establish reliability across plugin versions, operating conditions, or arbitrary transport failures.

attributed_claims.claim: Both transports restore the same underlying conversation and direct tests showed memory recall and forged-history detection.
attributed_claims.local_support_limit: No raw live-test result, rollout, or command log for that assertion is in the authorized boundary.

attributed_claims.claim: The Codex session witness is written by the Codex process and not by the gate.
attributed_claims.local_support_limit: The source reads a discovered file, but the inventory does not independently establish writer identity or write permissions.

attributed_claims.claim: Read-only review missed a negative-total defect that execution caught.
attributed_claims.local_support_limit: No linked raw comparative run is present in the boundary.

attributed_claims.claim: A perfect-chain forged session without a witness was rejected.
attributed_claims.local_support_limit: TST-LCI-001 covers different synthetic tamper cases and does not demonstrate this documentation example.

material_unknowns_and_gaps.statement: qa_gate.py does not itself validate parsed verdict JSON against verdict.schema.json.
material_unknowns_and_gaps.resolution: Exercise both transports with schema-negative verdict fixtures and retain raw transport records.

material_unknowns_and_gaps.statement: Postmortem witness material is recorded but not checked by cmd_verify.
material_unknowns_and_gaps.resolution: Specify and execute a postmortem-witness verification test before relying on the classification as authenticated evidence.

material_unknowns_and_gaps.statement: The actual environment's plugin version, model/version/effort, session-resumption fidelity, rollout immutability, sandbox enforcement, and reviewer verdict accuracy are not established by this local analysis.
material_unknowns_and_gaps.resolution: Version-pinned live run ledger, retained rollout records, deterministic sandbox probes, and blinded fault-corpus scoring.

material_unknowns_and_gaps.statement: The five declared eval cases have no executed QA records, scorer outputs, or results ledger in the inspected boundary.
material_unknowns_and_gaps.resolution: Frozen evaluator, per-case raw records, deterministic assertions, and an append-only evaluation ledger.

material_unknowns_and_gaps.statement: The source boundary declares no direct tests for lineage, criterion filtering, live resume, history detection, sandbox behavior, grounding capture, iteration logic, or postmortem behavior.
material_unknowns_and_gaps.resolution: Add a controlled evaluation record if and when separately authorized; do not retrospectively present new code as part of this analysis.

tests.source_identity_at_finalization: EVD-RVL-001 confirms that the tested source digest set is unchanged.
tests.conclusion: The two recorded regressions support only their named deterministic code paths; they do not establish live Codex, app-server, sandbox, rollout, or semantic-judging effectiveness.

prohibited_transformations: Do not describe fresh sessions, repeated samples, or postmortems as independent trust roots.
Do not convert hash-chain or rollout agreement into cryptographic provenance or reviewer-verdict correctness.
Do not report a local effectiveness result before the approved controlled evaluation produces raw records and deterministic scoring.
Do not recommend implementation from this record alone; implementation remains disallowed by EVD-GATE-001.
